Hiring update: we're looking for a senior backend engineer to join our platform team. You'll work mostly in Go and Postgres, with some Kubernetes on the side.

We're a remote-first company, but we ask everyone to meet in person twice a year. Salary range is $160k to $190k depending on experience.

If this sounds like you, apply on our careers page or send your resume to jobs@fernhill.dev.
